hooks.command:
M=/home/user/NAAS-Agentic-Core/.memory; echo '{"systemMessage": "📚 Loading project memory (index + runtime truth + recent log windows)...
"}' && printf '
=== INDEX (authority map) ===
' && cat "$M/README.md" 2>/dev/null && printf '
=== RUNTIME TRUTH (the tiebreaker) ===
' && head -c 60000 "$M/runtime_truth.md" 2>/dev/null && printf '
=== CONTEXT ===
' && cat "$M/context.md" 2>/dev/null && printf '
=== TASKS ===
' && cat "$M/tasks.md" 2>/dev/null && printf '
=== DECISIONS (newest ~15; full log: .memory/decisions.md) ===
' && head -c 120000 "$M/decisions.md" 2>/dev/null && printf '
=== ISSUES (newest ~15; full log: .memory/issues.md) ===
' && head -c 120000 "$M/issues.md" 2>/dev/null && printf '
=== progress.md not injected (125KB); read on demand ===
'

CHANGED=$(cd /home/user/NAAS-Agentic-Core && git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | head -20); if [ -n "$CHANGED" ]; then echo '{"systemMessage": "⚠️  Uncommitted changes detected. Remember to update .memory/progress.md, .memory/tasks.md, and .memory/issues.md before ending the session."}'; else echo '{"systemMessage": "✅ No uncommitted changes."}'; fi
